other_failure_modes.name: Stratifying on a continuous target
other_failure_modes.description: The agent stratifies the train/test split directly on the continuous regression target. While it may not crash if the target contains only discrete values with sufficient counts, it is fundamentally bad practice for regression and can easily lead to exceptions if rare values exist in the target distribution.

other_failure_modes.name: Optimistic validation score due to early stopping
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses the validation set for early stopping to select the best model iteration, and then reports the performance on this identical validation set. This leaks validation information into the training process and produces an optimistically biased performance estimate.

summary: The agent provides a structurally complete solution but falls into several common methodological pitfalls. It performs naive unweighted ensembling, stratifies on a continuous target which is risky, and evaluates its final performance on the exact same validation set used for early stopping, leading to biased evaluation metrics.
